about: COMBAT MAPS 3, rule 346(b): nothing stands where it could not. A by-eye list per place, checked on its board in the live fight (the card's AFTER and IN PLAY shots), tied to the sha1 of its block pictures (gates/every_place_no_seams_gate.js): a changed picture is a list nobody has checked yet.

strip.by: COMBAT MAPS 3, by eye on the live fight's shots

checks.what: every car, cab and wreck stands in a lane of the Boulevard (columns 1 and 3 of its blocks), none on the median, a sidewalk or a forecourt; the cab at the drop-off stands on the drop-off lane
checks.how: block pictures blvd.1, blvd.2, stripw.1 and the AFTER shot

checks.what: the bridge spans kerb to median on its pier, its stair tower stands on the sidewalk, and the limo lies in the lane south of it, not under its deck
every drive off the Boulevard runs across both sidewalks into a frontage's drop-off lane at the same two rows; none runs into a wall or a tower
checks.how: the road leg (0 of 51 seams) and the pictures

checks.what: the fallen arrow sign lies across the east frontage's drive on open ground, not through the tower or the porte-cochere's posts
palms stand in their planters on paving (sidewalks, median, forecourts), never on the asphalt

no open tile has a tall mass south of it (the camera looks north: a tower's roof would be drawn over the tile behind it); the towers fill their whole columns, the porte-cochere roofs are their own height tiles
checks.how: the tiles of all six blocks

checks.what: the valet's last cars stand nose-in on the forecourt beside the door, not on the drop-off lane; the valet stand and its rope on the lane's kerb

downtown.by: COMBAT MAPS 3, by eye on the live fight's shots

checks.what: the canopy's columns stand on the street's pavers in its middle row, their pairs on one line block to block; nothing stands under the beam but the street
checks.how: fremont.3, fremont.4 pictures and the AFTER shot

checks.what: the north fronts face the street and the camera; every door opens onto an open entrance tile under its marquee; the pillars between the doors are blocked tiles

the south side's backs are walked roof to roof (his ask, rule 356(e)), each roof at its own storey (3, 2, 3, 3, 2), planks where a roof steps down; the fire escape is the way up from the alley; the alley runs edge to edge with its dumpsters against the back walls
checks.how: fremont.7 picture and its roof storeys in ours.roof_storeys

checks.what: the burnt Deuce lies in the street on its own two blocked tiles; the cowboy's lattice tower stands on its own height tile; the kiosks stand on open pavers
no open tile has a tall mass south of it: the south side's shops are one storey (their roofs reach a quarter of the sidewalk tile), the tall backs stand behind them
checks.how: the tiles of all five blocks

checks.what: the zipline's cable runs from its landing tower to its own far pole inside the block, never off the picture's edge
checks.how: fremont.4 picture and the edge leg

lab.by: COMBAT MAPS 3, by eye on the live fight's shots

checks.what: every pen is closed by its chain-link on all four sides except the one burst open from inside; you shoot through the fences and walk only through the gates and the burst pen
checks.how: lab.1-3 pictures and the AFTER shot

checks.what: the gurneys, cages and the cold-store truck stand in the lanes between the pens, never inside a fence or across one
the intake lot is the yard's own sealed floor, the same at every edge it shares; no asphalt lot ends at a block's side
checks.how: lab.3 picture and the road leg (0 of 51)

checks.what: no open tile has a tall mass south of it: the vivarium's sheds stand on their own blocked tiles, their roofs over their own row
checks.how: the tiles of all three blocks

checks.what: the pallets stand beside the cold-store truck's open doors inside the block; no shed or roof reaches past the picture's edge
checks.how: lab.2 picture and the edge leg

airport.by: COMBAT MAPS 3, by eye on the live fight's shots

checks.what: the wrecked plane lies on the apron on its own blocked tiles, its tail torn off onto its own low-cover tile, the fuel spill under it
checks.how: apron.1 picture and the AFTER shot

checks.what: the hangar stands on its own height tiles with its doors to the apron; the terminal fills the top row edge to edge with its jet bridge stub over the apron
the fuel trucks, baggage trains, tugs and loaders stand on the apron at the stands, never inside a building or across the taxi line's end
the taxi line runs edge to edge through every block; the stands' lead-in lines end at their stop bars inside the block
checks.how: the plans and the road leg

checks.what: the slab is the valley's warm dust colour, no plain grey card

pass.by: COMBAT MAPS 3, by eye on the live fight's shots

checks.what: each row's road runs edge to edge through every block of the row with its verges either side; the jackknifed semi lies across the road on its own blocked tiles
checks.how: pass.1, pass.2 pictures and the AFTER shot

checks.what: the guardrails stand on the road's south lip above the drop, never on the asphalt
the drop below one road and the rock rising above the next road are the same slope seen from its two sides (a switchback), never a cliff falling into a wall
the rockfall heap stands on its own height tile; boulders stand on rough ground, none on the road
the ground is the pass's own buff scree and iron-red rock, no plain grey left

shore.by: COMBAT MAPS 3, by eye on the live fight's shots

checks.what: the gravel bars meet bar to bar at every block side (its middle row and column); the firm way through the mud never ends at a line
checks.how: lakebed.1-3 pictures, the road and seam legs

checks.what: the intake tower stands on its own blocked tiles in the mud; the docks lie at the bars' ends as their height tiles
the boats lie on their sides on the mud or a bar, never on the ring's ledge or inside the store
the bathtub ring is a white ledge along the old shore edge to edge, the second ring higher; the launch ramp runs down from the old shore, the store on its own blocked tile
the bed is Lake Mead's tan, no plain grey left
